claim.text: Recomputing r_d with CAMB/RECFAST at each MCMC point may change the quantified evidence within recorded uncertainty.

definitions: r_d is the baryon drag sound horizon used by the likelihood.
formalization.domain: cosmological parameter space declared by the target experiment
assumptions: Identical datasets and priors are used for the controlled comparison.
proof_obligations: Record data hashes, priors, chain diagnostics and residual systematics.

experiment.command: TOKEN_VAZIO: target repository must define the canonical CAMB/RECFAST execution command
inputs: Pantheon+/DESI/CMB artifacts identified by the target repository

falsifier.condition: The controlled recalculation fails reproducibility or contradicts the claimed numerical direction.

decision.next_action: Execute the target repository command and attach dual validator reports and artifact hashes.
decision.rollback: Keep the previous RLL claim ledger and no-new-claim safe state.
